needHint: Items from your video / build — e.g. fences, stairs, glass.
baseHint: Stop calculation here — e.g. if you already have planks, add oak planks instead of logs.
tagsHint: Pick wood type / variant when a recipe accepts several options.
errorNoTargets: Add at least one item to the list.
legend: A stack = 64 units (inventory slot size). E.g. 3 stacks + 12 = 204 items.
buildListSub: Items you requested — how much to gather or craft directly
craftListSub: Base ingredients after expanding recipes (logs, stone, etc.)
craftPrompt: Click Calculate materials to see crafting ingredients.
craftEmpty: No base materials — everything may already be in your base materials list.
emptyResults: Add items to the list and click Calculate to see craft materials.
unresolved: Some items have no recipe in the database: {list}
dataNotImported: Game data not found — import from your Minecraft client JAR first.
importRequired: Select your Minecraft client JAR to get started.
importRequiredHint: StackCraft will extract items, recipes, tags, and icons from the JAR you choose (official or third-party launcher).
importFailed: Could not extract game data. Pick a valid minecraft-client.jar. On Linux you may need unzip installed.
importSuccess: Import complete — you can search items and calculate materials.
footer: Minecraft data is generated locally · modular for future mods ·
